candidate_windows.window_text: In previous FSRE studies, there are mainly two types of model settings, differing in whether the model encoder is additionally pre-trained using a noisy Relation extraction(RE) corpus provided by Zhang and Lu (2022). In our experiments, as in previous work, we use BERT (Devlin et al., 2019) to initialize the encoder of our model. For optimization, AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019) is used with a linear warmup (Goyal et al., 2017) for the first $10\%$ steps. The learning rates of the encoder and generator are set to 1e-5, while those of the Aligner $\mathcal{A}$ and the generated classifiers are set to 4e-5 and 1e-2, respectively. Following previous work, we set the number of sampled episode $M$ at every training step to 4. It takes about ten hours for the whole training on a single 24 GB NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU. For testing, we use classification accuracy as the performance metric.
